note: Expanding Care: Doulas Program, List of Funding Recipients (OSDH, read 2026-10-02). Counties covered: Ellis (with support to Woodward) Newman Memorial Hospital will establish the Rural Oklahoma Doula Workforce Development Program in Ellis County with support to Woodward County. The program is a comprehensive hybrid training initiative designed to recruit, educate, certify, mentor, and retain community-based doulas who will improve maternal and infant health outcomes in underserved rural Oklahoma communities. Newman Memorial Hospital seeks to increase the availability of trained doulas serving rural Oklahoma, expand access to labor support for Medicaid beneficiaries, increase breastfeeding initiation, improve patient satisfaction, reduce unnecessary cesarean births, and improve maternal and infant health outcomes.

note: Expanding Care: Doulas Program, List of Funding Recipients (OSDH, read 2026-10-02). Counties covered: Beaver, Cimarron, Dewey, Ellis, Harper, Texas, and Woodward Western Plains Youth and Family Services will provide doula training, parent education, and provider education in NW Oklahoma. Training includes use of the Blossoming Birth Community Doula Training Curriculum with an in-house trainer to train others in-person. Parent education includes expanding doula care and education to expecting families through partnerships, education, collaboration, and outreach. Provider education includes expanding doula care and education to professionals such as health providers, students, future doulas, and support staff through partnerships, education, collaboration, and outreach.
